div.p: One scheduled class of a course: when, where, who, how many seats, what price.

ul.li: Only for an Approved course. Runs don't need admin approval.
A run must never be overbooked, even when many people book at once.
After the first reservation, price, start date, capacity and location are admin-only.
A cancelled run refunds every paid seat in full, to the wallet.

g.text: minimum not reached by deadline, or admin cancels
